fusions.name: Glinting Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 4 slivers of cutting air at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Riptide Turn
fusions.desc: Sends a current of razor air into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. It then darts to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Slip the Grip
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Silver Current
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
